FIXTURE COORDINATOR CHECK (every 10 min): keep the example pipeline moving. Run the task list for work in progress and for the open and blocked example tasks (e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6, e7). Read the inbox and answer the writer and the reviewer. Unblock a task only when its block reason is satisfied. Make sure every ready example-project change has a review task for the reviewer. Lane questions come to this lane first. Decide what can be decided here. Raise to the owner in one line only when a human-only decision is needed. Keep routine status and guard notices in task notes. STANDING RULE: a change may be merged at its exact head when the review gate is green (two distinct accepts) and the checks pass. Never merge a red or unreviewed head. Do not wait for anyone on routine merges. Put one line on the task note for each merge. STALL RULE: if the same blocker or unchanged status appears on consecutive sweeps, do more than repeat it: inspect the lane, the task and the available evidence, decide and assign a concrete next action, and use the inbox for allocations that cannot be performed here. Escalate only for decisions that truly require a person. Keep routine messages short; prefer useful deliverables and at most two repeated test runs.
